name: DashBoost
description: Merged lightweight performance optimizations for Geometry Dash.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master switch. Off bypasses Render Divider and disables the Fast Format hook.

fast-format.name: Fast Format
fast-format.description: Reduce temporary allocation overhead from Cocos formatted strings.

render-divider.name: Render Divider
render-divider.description: Render at the display target while allowing faster logic updates.

override-visual-fps.name: Override Visual FPS
override-visual-fps.description: Use a custom render target instead of the detected display refresh rate.

debugger.name: Debugger
debugger.description: Log live one-second performance counters to the Geode console.
